subject: Audit coverage snapshot & procurement renewal triggers
messages:
From: Alan Rice <alan.rice@brightedge.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@brightedge.ai
Date: Sat, 05 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: latest Type II + bridge options for renewal procurement

Hi Markus / Grace,

As we prepare BrightEdge's renewal packet (renewal effective 2026-10-15), Procurement asked for the most recent SOC 2 Type II report covering Redwood's production controls and any temporary coverage notes if the 2026 report will not be available before our PO cutoff.

Specifically we need:
- Latest Type II report PDF (date range noted)
- Is there a bridge letter or interim attestation available if the 2026 Type II is still in process? If so, what period does it cover?
- Confirmation of audit period overlap with our contract renewal window (Oct 1 - Oct 31).

Can you also confirm if a simple bridge attestation will satisfy our procurement/compliance team or whether a provisional attestation + evidence bundle is required? We aim to submit the renewal docs by 2026-09-20.

Thanks,
Alan
Alan Rice
Senior Sourcing Manager
BrightEdge Analytics

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
To: Alan Rice <alan.rice@brightedge.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 05 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: latest Type II + bridge options for renewal procurement

Hi Alan — thanks for the clear list. Quick answers up-front, then attaching details: we can provide our most recent SOC 2 Type II report (finalized 2024 audit period) and a bridge attestation template that covers interim coverage through the audit run for 2026.

Couple of clarifying asks so we send precisely what procurement needs:
- Do you require the full SOC 2 report PDF, or would redacted control sections suffice for legal/procurement review?
- For the bridge: do you need a signed QSA-style attestation, or is an internal bridge letter signed by our Head of Compliance acceptable?
- Any specific audit-period language procurement needs (e.g., explicit start/end dates, control exceptions)?

I've looped Laura from Legal for templating the bridge wording and Grace from Customer Success to coordinate evidence handoff if procurement needs artifacts.

I'll attach the current files now (SOC2 PDF + bridge template + a preliminary procurement checklist filled with our suggested answers). Assuming no unusual changes, we can produce a signed bridge letter by 2026-09-10.

Best,
Markus Klein
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
m: (415) 555-0192

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alan Rice <alan.rice@brightedge.ai>, procurement@brightedge.ai
Date: Sat, 05 Sep 2026 13:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: latest Type II + bridge options for renewal procurement

Markus / Grace — quick legal note and suggested wording for procurement:

1) Preferred deliverables
- Provide the full SOC 2 Type II report PDF for procurement review. If the external team specifically requests redactions, we can provide a redacted copy but procurement typically asks for the unredacted version for legal sign-off.

2) Bridge attestation options
- Option A (preferred): Signed bridge letter from Head of Compliance + link to supporting artifact bundle (control evidence index) describing the coverage window.
- Option B (if QSA required): Signed interim attestation reviewed by our QSA. This takes longer and requires QSA scheduling.

Suggested short bridge wording (to expedite):
"Redwood Inference confirms that controls described in our SOC 2 Type II report for the period [YYYY-MM-DD] through [YYYY-MM-DD] remain in effect as of the date of this letter. Pending completion of our current audit run, any material control changes will be communicated to BrightEdge and documented in an updated attestation."

3) Audit period phrasing
- If procurement's renewal window is Oct 1–31, we recommend explicitly stating the bridge covers up to Oct 31, 2026, so there is no coverage gap in their renewal paperwork.

If procurement requires the QSA-signed interim, we should escalate to Compliance + Finance because of cost and timing. Otherwise we can produce the internal bridge + evidence bundle by 2026-09-10 as Markus suggested.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Privacy | Redwood Inference
From: Alan Rice <alan.rice@brightedge.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@brightedge.ai
Date: Mon, 07 Sep 2026 08:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: latest Type II + bridge options for renewal procurement

Thanks Markus / Laura — that helps. A couple of follow-ups from procurement:
- The formal procurement team prefers the unredacted SOC 2 PDF for legal review. Can you confirm you will send the full PDF?
- For the bridge, our security reviewer needs explicit start/end dates. If you can state "coverage through 2026-10-31" that will close the renewal loop.
- Lastly, can you confirm an expected delivery date for the signed bridge letter and the evidence bundle (artifact index + sampled artifacts)? Our internal target remains 2026-09-20.

If you can commit to 2026-09-10 for the bridge and evidence bundle, procurement will start the PO workflow and we can sync signatures on our end.

—Alan
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.ai>

Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>

Alan — confirmed. Summary and next steps: 

1) We will send the unredacted SOC 2 Type II PDF to procurement via secure Drive link by EOD 2026-09-05 (attached earlier in thread).
2) Bridge letter: we will produce a signed internal bridge attestation stating coverage through 2026-10-31. Target delivery: 2026-09-10.
3) Evidence bundle: an index of artifacts + 3 sampled artifacts will be uploaded to the shared Drive link and provided to procurement with the bridge on 2026-09-10.

If procurement needs a QSA-signed interim attestation instead of an internal bridge, please flag by 2026-09-08 so we can escalate.

I'll follow up with the signed bridge PDF once Laura has signed off on the final text. Grace will be the point for the evidence handoff.

Markus
Senior Sales Engineer | Redwood Inference
